Subject: SearchGrid evaluation roadmap & MAP: embeddings + reranker performance tests

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation I’m attaching a one-page Mutual Action Plan (SG_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short eval instructions doc that lays out the performance objectives we’ll measure during the POC. High level plan:

- Objective: Validate embeddings + reranker endpoints meet SearchGrid latency and throughput requirements under representative load and concurrency.
- Deliverables: load-tested perf report (P50/P95 latencies, TTFT, throughput at target concurrencies), tuned config recommendations, cost / ops notes, and a final go/no-go recommendation.
- Datasets: we’ll use the sample queries you provided + a 100k candidate set (you indicated you can share a sanitized export). Please reply with drive access or confirm the dataset URL.
- Test matrix (proposed):
  • Embeddings endpoint: sequences of 128 tokens, batch sizes (1, 8, 32), concurrencies (64, 128, 256)
  • Reranker endpoint: 8 candidates per query, QPS targets (25, 100, 200), concurrent clients (32, 128)
  • Metrics: P50/P95 token latency, time-to-first-token (TTFT), sustained throughput (requests/sec), CPU/GPU utilization, and memory/KV cache hit rates.
- Environment: Hosted staging AWS region us-west-2 on A100-80GB nodes for the initial run; we can also benchmark H100 if you want a dedicated comparison.
- Schedule: propose run window week of 2026-03-29 with preliminary results by 2026-04-02. Final MAP signoff & next steps by 2026-04-06 to hit your April 20 go-live target.

Please confirm dataset links, whether you want H100 comparison, and if procurement has any constraints that would affect the timeline. I attached SG_MAP_v1.xlsx and eval_instructions.pdf for your review.

Next step: if you’re good, we’ll lock in a run slot and I’ll loop in Ben for test harness details.

—Karthik

Thanks — adding the technical plan so everyone has the details.

Planned harness & test specifics:
- Load generator: Locust + custom client to reproduce your QPS mix and candidate set sizes. We’ll open-source the harness config (loadtest-config.json).
- Model variants: redwood-emb-1 (dense 1536 dim), redwood-rerank-bert-large (cross-encoder), plus a quantized int8 variant for the reranker to compare tradeoffs.
- Hardware: baseline on A100-80GB (x4) in us-west-2; optional H100 run if you want numbers for cost comparison.
- Measurement details:
  • TTFT: time from HTTP request accepted to first token bytes on socket (we’ll capture server-side and client-side).
  • Latency: P50 / P95 for full response and per-stage breakdown (embedding encode, retrieval, reranker compute).
  • Throughput: sustained RPS for 5-minute intervals; ramp to peak over 2 minutes to detect instability.
- Concurrency sweep: 32, 64, 128, 256 for embeddings; 8/16/32 concurrent reranker workers with 8 candidates per query to measure end-to-end QPS.
- Data: 100k queries / 1M candidate vectors (to approximate your production tail distribution).
- Acceptance criteria (proposed):
  • Embeddings: P95 < 200ms at concurrency 128 and sustained throughput >= 600 TPS
  • Reranker: P95 < 900ms for 8-candidate rerank at 100 QPS sustained
  • TTFT: embeddings TTFT < 50ms; reranker TTFT < 150ms

We’ll run the initial full matrix week of 2026-03-29. Preliminary numbers will be posted to the shared Drive, and we’ll send an internal findings note + recommended tuning for any outliers. If these targets are missed we’ll propose configuration changes (batching, KV cache sizes, quantization, prefilling strategies).

Ben
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SearchGrid evaluation roadmap & MAP: embeddings + reranker performance tests — initial results and next steps

Team —

We completed the initial test matrix and uploaded the raw results (SG_perf_results_20260402.csv) plus an updated MAP (SG_MAP_v2.xlsx) with a proposed close timeline. Summary highlights (short version):

Embeddings endpoint (redwood-emb-1) — A100 baseline:
- P50: 12 ms, P95: 48 ms (full request), TTFT median: 18 ms
- Sustained throughput: 920 TPS at concurrency=256, with acceptable CPU/GPU utilization (70-82% on A100).
- Observations: KV prefix caching improved end-to-end latency by ~22% on repeated prefixes; batching beyond 32 gave diminishing returns for short sequence lengths.

Reranker endpoint (redwood-rerank-bert-large) — A100 baseline, int8 comparison:
- Full response P50: 85 ms, P95: 420 ms (8 candidates), TTFT median: 95 ms
- Sustained end-to-end QPS: 220 QPS for 8-candidate rerank at 32 concurrent workers
- Quantized int8 build: ~18-24% throughput uplift, P95 increased slightly (worst-case +40ms) — useful tradeoff if cost is primary constraint.

Stability notes:
- We ran spike scenarios (+40% instantaneous traffic); embeddings remained within P95 targets but reranker P95 spiked to ~1.2s for ~90s under the heaviest burst before autoscaling stabilized the pool. We recommend pre-warming or a small reserved buffer for bursty production traffic.

Cost & ops notes:
- Estimated hosted cost to meet the tested profile (sustained): ~$6,800/day vs. Dedicated reserved pool estimate (12-month commitment) ~$3,900/day equivalent (includes reserved capacity discount and predictable throughput). Exact numbers are in the attached CSV.

Recommendations & next steps:
1) For April 20 pilot: proceed with Dedicated reserved pool (12-month) with a small burst buffer (20% headroom). Draft SOW adjustments and SLA addendum look feasible — legal can iterate on the P99 clause.
2) If SearchGrid prefers lower capex, enable quantized reranker in production with careful monitoring for regressions; we’ll include a regression checklist tied to your eval prompts.
3) Run a final production-sim test week of 2026-04-12 to validate autoscaling and cache warmup behaviors before go-live.

Action items assigned in the MAP (SG_MAP_v2.xlsx):
- Redwood: provide final dedicated quote + SLA addendum by 2026-04-06 (Karthik, Marissa)
- SearchGrid: procurement signoff target 2026-04-15 (Darren)
- Joint: production-sim run 2026-04-12 — results by 2026-04-16 (Ben to run, Hannah to validate)

Attachments uploaded: SG_MAP_v2.xlsx, SG_perf_results_20260402.csv, loadtest-config.json. Let me know if you want raw logs or additional H100 comparison — we can run that in 24-48 hours.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
